final.title: Overdue health insurance payment notice
steps: Pay 286,370원 by November 25, 2026 to virtual account 562-01-998877 (account holder: 국민건강보험공단).
If you cannot pay the full amount at once, you can apply for an installment payment plan.
If you have already paid, you can ignore this notice; any overpaid amount will be refunded.
final.objection: If you disagree with this notice, you can file an objection within 90 days from the date you received it.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, your assets (such as bank deposits) may be seized under Article 15 of the National Health Insurance Act, and your visa extension (extension of stay) may be restricted under the Immigration Control Act.
corrected: read as "남부할 금액" / "남부납 금액", understood as "납부할 금액" (amount to pay)
read as "체류기간 연장 가해", understood as "체류기간 연장 허가" (permission to extend period of stay)

explained.title: National Health Insurance overdue payment notice
steps: Pay the total amount of 286,370원 by November 25, 2026, using the virtual account 562-01-998877.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, your property (such as bank accounts and deposits) may be seized under Article 15 of the National Health Insurance Act, and the extension of your period of stay may be restricted under the Immigration Act.

final.title: Local income tax payment notice
steps: Pay 422,610원 by December 31, 2026 to virtual account 801-26-4418-90372 (account holder: 영등포구청), or pay via Wetax ARS at 1588-2112 using electronic payment number 11560-2-26-12-0730418.
If you have already paid, keep your payment receipt for 5 years.
final.objection: If you disagree with this notice, you can file an objection (이의신청) or request a review (심사청구) within 90 days from the date you received it.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by the deadline, a 3% late payment penalty is added (increasing the total to 435,280원 until January 31, 2027), and 0.75% is added each month after that. If the tax remains unpaid, your bank deposits, wages, or real estate may be seized, and as a foreign resident you may face disadvantages during visa or stay permit reviews.
corrected: read as "남부할 세액" / "남부기한" / "남부지연가산세", understood as "납부할 세액" / "납부기한" / "납부지연가산세" (tax to pay / payment due date / late payment penalty)
read as "하사 실시" / "하가 실시", understood as "허가 심사" (permit or visa review)

explained.title: Local Income Tax Bill
steps: Pay the amount of 422,610원 using the virtual account 801-26-4418-90372 by December 31, 2026.
explained.if_ignored: A late payment fee of 3% will be added, and the amount will increase to 435,280원 if paid by January 31, 2027. Further delay may result in additional monthly increases of 0.75% and the seizure of property such as deposits and real estate, as well as disadvantages for foreigners during stay processing.
corrected: read as "남기 내 금액", understood as "납기 내 금액" (amount due within the deadline)
read as "기보부세액", understood as "기납부세액" (previously paid tax amount)

final.title: Formal demand to pay overdue property tax
steps: Pay 1 360,00 € by January 11, 2027, either online at impots.gouv.fr or by bank transfer, quoting reference 2633 9075 1204 0841.
If you have difficulty paying, contact your tax office at 05 56 24 87 30 or via secure messaging on impots.gouv.fr before January 11, 2027 to request a payment plan.
final.objection: You can contest this formal demand in writing to the public accountant within two months of receiving it (Article L. 281 of the LPF).
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay by January 11, 2027, the public accountant may start enforcement proceedings, including seizing money from your bank accounts or wages, and enforcement fees of 3% (minimum 7,50 €) will be added to your debt.

steps: Pay the amount of 1 360,00 € on impots.gouv.fr or by bank transfer, indicating the reference 2633 9075 1204 0841, by January 11, 2027.

final.title: Request for additional residence permit documents
steps: Gather the four required documents: your current employment contract signed by both parties, your last three payslips (September to November 2026), proof of address less than 6 months old (such as a utility bill or rent receipt), and your work authorization issued by the ANEF platform.

Upload all four documents to your ANEF account (administration-etrangers-en-france.interieur.gouv.fr) under the section "Compléter ma demande" by January 8, 2027. Do not send them by mail or bring them in person.
Check your ANEF account for an appointment summons in case one is needed.
final.if_ignored: If you do not submit the documents by January 8, 2027, your application will be closed without further action. After your extension certificate expires on February 19, 2027, you will no longer be able to prove your legal residence status or your right to work.

explained.title: Request for additional documents for residence permit
steps: Upload the following documents to your ANEF space (administration-etrangers-en-france.interieur.gouv.fr) under the section "Compléter ma demande": current employment contract signed by both parties, last three payslips from September to November 2026, proof of address less than 6 months old (such as a utility bill or rent receipt), and work authorization issued by the ANEF platform.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not provide the documents within the indicated time limit, your application will be closed without further action and you will no longer be able to justify the legality of your stay or your right to work after your extension certificate expires.
